stature.basis: Drawn from the stature of US Army recruits of 1815-20, 68.1 in on average (Sokoloff 1984), with the 2.5 in spread of the period's registers; no measure of him is known.

basis: His complexion (dark), hair (brown) and eyes (hazel) are drawn in the register's own words from what the Register of Enlistments wrote of 199 men of the 22nd US Infantry, 1812-14; his own entry has not been read. The short crop is our choice for a soldier of the time.

reference.title: Alexander Anderson
reference.licence: The Met Open Access, public domain
reference.why: A stand-in: a period face of like colouring (very dark brown to black, short, with sideburns; light olive-warm skin, rosy cheeks, dark brows; stubble shadow), not his likeness.

replaceable_by: His entry in the Register of Enlistments (NARA M233), which gives his height, complexion, eyes and hair.
